_meta.principle: Spatial layering ONLY. Foreground / midground / background content prompts. Three-layer images read as cinematic; flat single-plane images read as snapshots. Ownership boundary: depth does NOT describe lens DoF behavior (that lives in lens.json).
sources: Higgsfield AI tutorial transcript 2026-05-03 (depth as one of four cinematic dimensions)
_meta.interpolation_rule: Paste fragment verbatim into the depth clause. Caller may need to specify what occupies each layer in the brief if the recipe doesn't infer it.

deep_focus_three_layer.name: Deep three-layer composition
deep_focus_three_layer.use: Foreground element + midground subject + background context, all readable. The Higgsfield default for cinematic feel.
deep_focus_three_layer.fragment: clear foreground element framing the shot, the main subject in the midground at focal distance, atmospheric background context behind, three distinct layers of depth all contributing to the composition

mid_ground_anchor.name: Midground subject anchor
mid_ground_anchor.use: Subject placed in midground with foreground/background atmosphere. Less rigid than deep three-layer.
mid_ground_anchor.fragment: subject anchored in the midground at natural focal distance, soft atmosphere in front and behind, the eye drawn to the middle plane

foreground_object_blur.name: Foreground object soft-blurred
foreground_object_blur.use: An object in the foreground partially occluding the subject, slightly blurred. Adds depth and intimacy. Plant leaves, glass, fabric, etc.
foreground_object_blur.fragment: an object in the immediate foreground partially framing the shot and slightly blurred, the subject sharp behind it in the midground, the foreground element creating intimacy and depth

silhouette_layered_back.name: Silhouettes against bright back
silhouette_layered_back.use: Foreground/midground subjects in silhouette against bright background (window, sunset, fire). Drama, anonymity, scale.
silhouette_layered_back.fragment: subject in silhouette against a brightly lit background, the figure's outline clearly defined against light, layered depth created by the contrast between dark foreground and luminous background

flat_no_depth.name: Flat single-plane
flat_no_depth.use: Deliberately flat composition. Used only when flatness is the point — billboard ads, formal portraits, technical product. Most images should NOT pick this.
flat_no_depth.fragment: flat single-plane composition without atmospheric depth, all elements at roughly the same focal distance, deliberately graphic and two-dimensional
flat_no_depth.warning: Default cinematic look needs depth. Only pick this when flatness serves the message.

compressed_telephoto_layers.name: Compressed telephoto layers
compressed_telephoto_layers.use: Long-lens look where multiple layers of subject (street crowd, mountain ranges) appear stacked closer than they are. Used for environmental compression. NOTE: while this references a long-lens visual, the LENS choice is in lens.json — this entry is about the spatial result.
compressed_telephoto_layers.fragment: multiple layers of subject and environment compressed visually so they appear stacked close together despite real distance, the depth-flattening effect that makes a busy scene feel dense and layered
